manual.assortedutil.chapter.graves.info:
When you die, everything you carried and all of your experience goes into a grave where you died.

Items with Curse of Vanishing still vanish.
manual.assortedutil.chapter.graves.resto:
Right-click on your grave to get everything back where it was.

Breaking it spills it all on the ground instead. Explosions, pistons and bosses cannot move or break a grave.
manual.assortedutil.description: Graves, double doors, an item replacer, a clock, a light level overlay and damage numbers.
manual.assortedutil.title: Assorted Util
message.assortedgraves.grave.dug: Your belongings are in a grave at %s, %s, %s.
